# korao.ai — Premium AI Domain For Sale

> A concise, brandable, and future-ready .ai domain for artificial intelligence startups, AI agencies, model labs, and next-generation tech products.

## Key Facts

- Domain: korao.ai
- TLD: .ai (official ccTLD for Anguilla, de facto global AI industry TLD)
- Length: Short, memorable, one-word brandable name (7 chars before TLD)
- Category: Premium domain acquisition (digital asset)
- Ideal for: AI startups, LLM developers, AI tools, automation platforms, intelligent SaaS, venture brands
- Escrow: Secured via Escrow.com or Dan.com

## Features

- Clean, modern brand identity
- Easy pronunciation and high recall
- Native AI vertical fit
- Rare short-name .ai availability
- Globally accessible spelling and phonetics

## Acquisition Process

1. Submit inquiry via on-site form at https://www.korao.ai
2. Offer review and verification
3. Escrow setup (Escrow.com or Dan.com)
4. Secure domain transfer
5. Ownership confirmation
